description: This file defines the HighWaterMarkService class, which manages high water mark logic for billing and subscriptions, including updating, resetting, and applying high water marks based on team member counts and feature flags.

classes.name: HighWaterMarkService
classes.description: A service class for managing high water mark logic related to billing, including updates, resets, and application to subscriptions.

methods.name: shouldApplyHighWaterMark
methods.description: Determines if high water mark logic should be applied for a specific team based on feature flag and billing period.

methods.name: updateHighWaterMarkOnSeatAddition
methods.description: Updates the high water mark when a seat is added, based on current team member count and billing info.

methods.name: resetHighWaterMark
methods.description: Resets the high water mark to current team member count at the start of a new billing period.

methods.name: applyHighWaterMarkToSubscription
methods.description: Applies the high water mark to a subscription, potentially scaling the subscription up or down based on team member count.

methods.name: getHighWaterMarkData
methods.description: Retrieves high water mark data for a specific team.

methods.name: resetSubscriptionAfterRenewal
methods.description: Resets the subscription quantity to current team members after a billing renewal, allowing seats to scale down.
